## Introduction

This vignette guides you through the process of reproducing and analyzing occurrence data for the **Gouldian Finch** in Australia. The data is sourced from the [Atlas of Living Australia (ALA)](https://www.ala.org.au/), cleaned, enriched with weather information, and visualized.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Load Required Packages and Utilities

Required functions are included in `vignette-utils.R`, which you can load using:



::: {.cell}

:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
organism_name = "gouldian_finch"
organism_title = "Gouldian Finch"
```
:::



------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you want to match quarter data use this code:



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# 1. Aggregate manta observations to quarter
manta_quarter <- manta_rays %>%
  mutate(quarter = floor_date(date, "quarter")) %>%
  count(quarter, name = "manta_sightings")

# 2. Make sure tourism$quarter is also floor_date
tourism_clean <- tourism %>%
  mutate(quarter = floor_date(quarter, "quarter"))

# 3. Left join: keep all manta quarters, match tourism by quarter
manta_tourism <- manta_quarter %>%
  left_join(tourism_clean, by = "quarter")
```
:::
